name: Shinobi no Hana ~Kunoichi Shimai no Chousen~
original_name: 忍ノ華 ～くノ一姉妹の挑戦～
source:
Main character is an unsuccessful detective who struggles to catch a gangster girl.
One evening he hears a rumor that the legendary thief is going to rob the art museum at night. When he arrives at the destination he finds there the Kaito group of female ninja who accumulate wealth to revive the ninjutsu art. The mystery gradually deepens.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-may-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是个不得志的侦探，一直想抓住一名女黑帮成员。
某晚，他听说传说中的怪盗将在夜里盗取美术馆。抵达现场后，他发现一群女忍者早已聚集在此。她们为了复兴忍术而四处敛财，事件背后的谜团也由此逐渐加深。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-may-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
